clips.title: The story
paras: At Northshire's vineyards, Garrick Padfoot's severed head proves the cutthroat is dead. The authorities at Northshire Abbey require it to pay the bounty.

Garrick Padfoot and his gang harassed Northshire Valley's farmers and merchants for weeks. With Stormwind's defenses stretched thin, Garrick made his hideout in a shack near the vineyards and raided passing trade. Local guards were occupied by kobolds and Defias bandits, so Deputy Willem offered a bounty for the outlaw's death. He sought someone willing to kill Garrick and bring back proof.
